newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Surgut Holding raises stake in Surgutneftegaz.
newsitem.headline: Surgut Holding raises stake in Surgutneftegaz.

text.p: NK Surgutneftegaz (Surgut Holding) has raised its stake in OAO Surgutneftegaz, Russia's second biggest oil company by sales, to 43.5 percent from 38 percent, a Surgut Holding statement on Thursday showed.

Surgut Holding said it had acquired an entire new issue of Surgutneftegaz shares, comprising 500 million ordinary shares and 34.02 million preferred shares, each with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles.
The issue was approved by Surgutneftegaz's board of directors, within the limits of its authorised capital, and distributed via a closed subscription, the Surgut Holding statement said.
The issue took Surgutneftegaz's capital to 5.998 trillion roubles, or 5.998 billion shares, comprising 4.62 billion ordinary shares and 1.37 billion preferred shares.
Surgut Holding had previously owned 38 percent of Surgutneftegaz.
Surgut Holding is the third biggest by production and reserves of a dozen vertically integrated Russian oil companies set up over the last few years. Its sole production unit is Surgutneftegaz.
At 1045 GMT Surgutneftegaz ordinaries were $0.467 and Surgutneftegaz preferred were $0.279, after closing on Wednesday at $0.462 and $0.290 respectively.
